label: ილუსტრირებული ზღაპარი
about: Animated fable cartoon template with character gestures, trials, and moral takeaway

beats.show: the robot and the title, on screen at frame 0
its name chip pops, the antenna blinks
the easel rises beside it
the arm moves, a scribble draws, the second line inverts
chapter 2: the first sheet, the pencil starts
the circle comes out a square
the second sheet slides in
it comes out a wave; the robot tilts its head
the robot nods: it doesn't give up
a row of days, each sheet with one more line
the newest line lands, in the accent
chapter 3: one big sheet
a round circle draws at last
it fills warm
rays grow: a sun rises; the robot smiles
the moral in big type
the line climbs like stairs, the dot goes up
the end card
the link and the QR
the call to action

use: engine compose scaffold <story> --template fable-story: fill slots.json (a fact slot: "=<fact id>" from facts.json; a words slot: the words) and beats.json's anchors
